checkpoints.description: [1/2] Tighten the hygiene false-positive fix: flag env deletes and read io.open modes correctly

impact_assessment.why: The last fix skipped every non-Load environ subscript, hiding a hard del that raises; it also read io.open(path, 'rb') as a Path method, taking the path as the mode and flagging a binary open as text.
impact_assessment.benefits: Environment deletes are flagged like reads, while io.open binary and text modes are classified by the builtin signature.

[1/2] Review the last 36 pushes: fsync the hook directory after the atomic replace

impact_assessment.why: install_pre_push_hook fsyncs the temp file and replaces it but never fsyncs the containing directory, so on POSIX a power loss can revert the rename and leave the project unguarded.
impact_assessment.benefits: The hook rename is durable like every other PRINCIPLE-013 state write; Windows stays a no-op.
